mapper.select: select task_id, requirement_id, task_name, task_priority, plan_id, plan_code, flow_instance_id, execution_attempt, task_status, end_reason, event_time, create_time, update_time from experiment_task order by event_time desc, task_id
mapper.insert: insert into experiment_task ( task_id, requirement_id, task_name, task_priority, plan_id, plan_code, flow_instance_id, execution_attempt, task_status, end_reason, event_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{taskId}, #{requirementId}, #{taskName}, #{taskPriority}, #{planId}, #{planCode}, #{flowInstanceId}, #{executionAttempt}, #{taskStatus}, null, #{eventTime}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp ) on conflict (task_id) do update set requirement_id = excluded.requirement_id, task_name = excluded.task_name, task_priority = excluded.task_priority, plan_id = excluded.plan_id, plan_code = excluded.plan_code, flow_instance_id = excluded.flow_instance_id, execution_attempt = excluded.execution_attempt, task_status = excluded.task_status, end_reason = null, event_time = excluded.event_time, update_time = current_timestamp where excluded.execution_attempt > experiment_task.execution_attempt or (excluded.execution_attempt = experiment_task.execution_attempt and experiment_task.task_status = #{taskStatus})

insert into experiment_task ( task_id, requirement_id, task_name, task_priority, plan_id, plan_code, flow_instance_id, execution_attempt, task_status, end_reason, event_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{taskId}, #{requirementId}, #{taskName}, #{taskPriority}, #{planId}, #{planCode}, #{flowInstanceId}, #{executionAttempt}, #{taskStatus}, #{endReason}, #{eventTime}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp ) on conflict (task_id) do update set requirement_id = excluded.requirement_id, task_name = excluded.task_name, task_priority = excluded.task_priority, plan_id = excluded.plan_id, plan_code = excluded.plan_code, flow_instance_id = excluded.flow_instance_id, execution_attempt = excluded.execution_attempt, task_status = excluded.task_status, end_reason = excluded.end_reason, event_time = excluded.event_time, update_time = current_timestamp where excluded.execution_attempt >= experiment_task.execution_attempt
